# Subway Seat for Palette JSON

The whole palette as data: every flavor and role in hex, RGB and HSL, with names, uses, ANSI order, diff tints and syntax roles. subway-seat.tokens.json is the same in W3C design-token form for Tokens Studio and Style Dictionary.

[Palette JSON](https://github.com/oddurs/subway-seat) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/json/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | read it from any script or tool |
| All three | [`subway-seat.tokens.json`](subway-seat.tokens.json) | `tokens/subway-seat.tokens.json`; in your project, as a Style Dictionary source; Tokens Studio loads it with Load from file |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.walnut.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.tunnel.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in any script or tool that reads JSON:

```sh
jq -r '.flavors.enamel.colors.orange.hex' subway-seat.json
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `tokens/subway-seat.tokens.json`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
